data.raw_text:
#SupremeCourtPH (SC) Senior Associate Justice (SAJ) Marvic M.V.F. Leonen urged the justice sector to refocus discussions on addressing jail congestion to human dignity, emphasizing that decongesting overcrowded detention facilities should not just be a temporary relief, but a necessary step toward a more humane, rational, and just judicial system.

In his message during the Second National Decongestion Summit on January 23, 2026 in Manila, SAJ Leonen called for a rethinking of what the country’s penal philosophy should be and pointed to the need to recenter the conversation on human dignity.
